start: A member's page as owner; the member has a running plan, a batch and a desk photo

user_sees: A credit-card-size card: gym name, name, photo, 'No.' as 8 digits in two groups, 'Mobile' masked like 98XXX X3210, 'Plan', 'Valid till' (the last covered day, renewals included), 'Batch', and a QR
must_not: The full mobile number on the card; 'Valid till' showing only the current term when a renewal is already bought
The panel's menu or buttons on the printed page; a card cut over two pages

start: The same member's card as owner; other ways out: save as a picture, send on WhatsApp

steps.action: Save the card as a picture
must_not: A file name with the member's name or mobile in it

user_sees: WhatsApp opens to the member with 'Hi <first name>!' and 'Here is your <gym> member card (No. <number>). Please show it at the desk.'; the desk attaches the picture itself
must_not: A message sent without the desk pressing send in WhatsApp; a claim that the picture is attached

start: As owner, the card of a member with no running plan, no batch, no photo and a foreign or very short mobile number

user_sees: 'Plan' says 'No active plan'; no 'Valid till' row; no 'Batch' row; initials in place of the photo; a foreign number keeps its first two and last four digits with X between; 4 digits or fewer are all X; a blank number shows a dash
must_not: An old end date shown as 'Valid till'; a broken-picture mark; more of the number than the mask allows

start: As owner, a member whose card was printed; then the plan is renewed, later it lapses

steps.action: Renew the plan and open 'Member card' again
user_sees: 'Valid till' moves to the new last day; 'No.' is the same as before
must_not: A new member number; the old date kept

steps.action: Open the card after the plan has ended
must_not: The lapsed plan still shown as valid
